item.title: COMING Thursday, Nov 12 | Bluegrass and BBQ ft. The JackTown Ramblers — Sun Oct 25 — The Farm – A Gathering Place
item.description:
Thursday November 12 | Doors open at 5pm, Dinner 6 pm, Music 7-9 pm | $59.95 Event Details and Tickets Smoked BBQ, warm cornbread, and the JackTown Ramblers playing all night, fifteen minutes from downtown Asheville.
When the evenings turn cool in the mountains, this is the kind of dinner we want to gather around. Smoked BBQ chicken. Fried catfish with remoulade. Cornbread muffins with honey butter, still warm from the oven. Banana pudding to finish. It’s the food these hills are known for, cooked by the Farm Kitchen and passed down the table.
Live bluegrass from the JackTown Ramblers The JackTown Ramblers are a four-piece string band from western North Carolina. Their sets blend traditional bluegrass with swing tunes, a little gypsy jazz, and songs of their own, and they’ve become a familiar name on stages across the region.

item.description:

We believe these experiences support emotional well-being, reduce stress, and strengthen our community. Featuring: Lo Wolf Captivated at an early age by this incredible instrument, Lo has a unique and improvisational style honed by years of study in the classical and Celtic modes. She brings her singer-songwriter sensibilities to bear and draws on the world around her to create soothing and memorable soundscapes that reflect the beauty she sees. item.title: Sanders, Boyd, Page & Hall — Tue Nov 10, 8:00 PM — Little Jumbo: 241 Broadway St.
item.description:
Every atom in your body was forged in the belly of a dying star. The calcium in your bones, the iron in your blood, the carbon threading through every strand of your DNA — all of it cooked at temperatures beyond human language, scattered across the void, and reassembled over billions of years into something that walks into a bar on a Tuesday night and listens.
Sanders, Boyd, Page & Hall are four collections of stellar debris who have chosen to spend their brief window of consciousness making original music together. Not playing songs. Not running repertoire. Building something in real time from the raw material of attention, instinct, and decades of accumulated craft — compositions that didn't exist before these particular particles arranged themselves around instruments in this part...

item.title: Benevolent Order of the Creature, Lodge No. 241 — Tue Nov 17, 8:00 PM — Little Jumbo: 241 Broadway St.
item.description:
No one can say when the Lodge was founded, only that the Creature was already in the corner when the columns went up, when the paper sun was first hung and made to burn, when the grass was cut from green stock and persuaded to grow. Four amber eyes, arranged in no order known to symmetry, and a patience older than the room. It does not perform. It presides. The musicians are merely the part of the night that moves.
Membership is not applied for. You are admitted the moment you stop noticing the difference between the clouds overhead and the ceiling they hang from, the moment a held note outlasts the breath that started it and you forget which one of you is dreaming the other. The Order keeps minutes from a meeting that never adjourned. Its single bylaw is sympathetic vibration: strik...
